description: Erection of a part single storey and part two storey rear extension, two-storey side extension and side roof extension to the house, conversion of garage into a habitable room
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (100, Existing Plans and Elevations received 4 October 2022; Proposed Side Section, Proposed Plans and Elevations, Fire Safety Plan, Fire Safety Block Plan received 15 November 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Within one planting season of the removal of the trees, four replacement trees shall be replanted as near to the location of the felled tree as possible. The tree(s) shall be of  'Standard' size i.e. with a single stem with clear trunk at least 1.8 metres and a girth of not less than 8-10 centimetres at a point one metre above ground level at the time of planting and shall be maintained in perpetuity. Should a replacement tree die or become seriously damaged or moribund, then a further replacement tree to the same specification shall be planted immediately.
